ices.b_interpretation: GE and With Egestion include natural mortality and internal catch-return recycling; TE now has an actual coupled catch-return recycling matrix. Its old b=0 was a no-return convention, not a measured comparison value.
source_loader_interpretation: Global source-preserving loader/accounting correction; normal maintained loader with no model-local adaptation.
Standalone source routing, including explicit zeros, is read by the repaired shared loader; field-by-field reconciliation is retained.
Source parameters and missingness remain canonical; only documented nonfeeding structural diet conventions apply in runtime.

Known detritus BA is retained before the EE floor. The floor retains its established effective detritus-stock closure, which is not observed accumulation or a recovered native export. Operational detritus EE=1 remains a calculation convention.
No LIM, invented catch/BA/GS default, runtime diet normalization, or normalization-induced BA correction is requested.
EE floor ON at .1 is an explicit current runtime assumption; it is not source correction or approval.

comparison_limitations: Not a controlled common-settings comparison: ICES uses repaired engine and EE floor 0.1; Scotland uses restored archived historical engine with EE floor OFF and corrected seabird-diet/derived-BA variant.
ICES TE b is a coupled catch-return recycling metric; Scotland historical TE b=0 is the no-detritus-recycling convention. Do not rank recycling by these b values across implementations.
Latest Scotland retained variant is GE OK, TE WARN, With Egestion OK. Earlier Scotland baseline FAIL and 1.669% diet-only PP gap are superseded for this corrected variant.
Scotland signature excludes Seabirds, Seals and Cetaceans because GE<0.01; retained diagnostics do not implement these exclusions. No post-exclusion diagnostic matrix was established by this review.
ICES declared domain covers about 87% of LME_022 versus Scotland about 40% (37-42% source-map sensitivity), but geographic advantage does not establish scientific validity.
ICES port differs materially from unavailable accepted native Key Run; convergence and PP closure do not resolve this or the EE-floor/effective detritus assumptions.
Taxon mapping review is owned by the parallel mapping stage; no ICES or Scotland mappings/weights were changed or reassessed here.

report_ready_comparison_prose: The latest ICES loader-repair diagnostics are WARN for GE, TE and With Egestion; all source-resolved entries are finite and nonnegative and both strict balance flags are true. Source diet rounding, expensive Discards-derived production, GE/With Egestion recycling gain and five near-zero TE groups remain material warnings. The latest Scotland corrected runtime variant is GE OK, TE WARN and With Egestion OK, also with both strict balance flags true and no negative/nonfinite matrix entries. Its matrices precede the signed exclusion of Seabirds, Seals and Cetaceans (GE<0.01). This is a comparison of retained configurations, not a common-settings experiment: ICES uses the repaired engine with EE floor 0.1, while Scotland uses the historical engine without the floor. ICES has broader declared geographic coverage (about 87% versus about 40% of LME_022), but its port differs from the unavailable accepted native Key Run and its mortality-floor/effective-detritus closures remain runtime assumptions.
